instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Start a decision my AI will make with my method: what is being decided, the facts and constraints, and the options only if I already hold them", and give it source_id (Unique text naming where this decision comes from); goal (What is being decided); evidence.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:start-a-decision and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Opens a decision in the person's own records from a source_id (the same source always opens the same decision; the same input again is that decision, different input is refused), its goal, its evidence ({ref, claim}, each ref unique: the facts and every non-negotiable constraint) and, only when the caller already holds them, at least two options ({id, label}); with no options the method's own steps generate the candidates and rule them out, and what the rule-out step leaves standing are the options, under the method named or the person's default (their Methods list).

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: decision (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-revision (records:read, records:write); decision-step (records:read, records:write); decision-call (records:write); decision-evidence (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-answered-step (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-option (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-candidate (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-report (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-carried-out (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-history (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-cited-pursuit (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-method (records:read, records:write); decision-part (records:read, records:write); decision-refs (records:read, records:write); pursuit (records:read, records:list); record:check (records:list, records:read); record:decision-kind (records:list).
